sections.name: Black Warrior River at Oliver Lock and Dam (tailwater)

sentences.text: Latest reading: 95.47 ft at Sun 11/22 11:30 AM CST (0.5 hours before this briefing).
The river is steady (+0.01 ft over 6 hours, -0.16 ft over 24 hours).
No flooding: 26.53 ft below action stage (122 ft).
The NWS forecast issued Sun 11/22 8:29 AM CST does not expect the river to rise above its current level through Fri 11/27 6:00 AM CST.
NWS forecasts here only account for rain expected about 48 hours past the time they're issued.
